connector.name: Conductor Graph MCP
connector.registryDescription: Exposes a CognOS agent system as a machine-readable graph. Full system snapshot with one tool call.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package conductor-graph-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the base76-research-lab account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: COGNOS_BASE_URL
env.description: URL of the TrustPlane/CognOS gateway (default: http://127.0.0.1:8788)

env.name: COGNOS_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the CognOS gateway (optional, leave empty if not required)
